Hello,
On February 25 around 5:30 PM CU TIME, a client attempted to charge with POS on the charger
170002732 but on the screen he saw that the connector 2 Type2 was in status "Occupied". The connector was available, and we saw that it was available on our portals and on the App.
We analyzed the POS and the reason the client saw the connector in that status is that there was a transaction still in status "finishing" from 25/02 at 10:59 AM CU TIME. The connector became available on February 26 at 10:35 AM CU TIME.
The reason it happened appears to be related to the charger, since the "stop session" requests were all refused by the charger.
Can you please check the logs for the timestamps I provided and give us more information on the reason why the "stop session" requests were denied?
Thank you
software version
: v8.0.5-0-g33a6c1d+APN

additional_info.subject: ID0481021-DC/Si-D/IT- [MP / R9 170002732] Logs Check CRM:03289000661
additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following you report, and after checking the logs in the given timestamp, we see that the issue was related to errorcode 1.
As you can see in the logs, the errorcode 1 is related to the ecog.
This issue can be caused by a bug in the system, which can be resolved by performing a reboot, which in this case also resolved the issue.
We will monitor the charger the next three days to see if the issue comes back.
At this moment the charger looks healthy with no errorflags showing.
We hope to have informed you enough.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
